title: Generalist (Sales)
description: Turn new conversations into opportunities. Build a sales pipeline through prospecting, customer conversations and consistent follow-ups.
details: Prospect for potential customers, qualify leads, understand customer needs and support sales conversations. Maintain accurate CRM records, coordinate next steps and follow up consistently to move opportunities forward. Track pipeline activity and outcomes, and use what you learn to improve outreach and the customer experience.

title: Generalist (Operations)
description: Keep daily work moving. Coordinate workflows, resolve operational issues and make processes simpler and more reliable.
details: Coordinate day-to-day workflows and follow through on tasks across teams. Identify and resolve operational issues, communicate progress and escalate blockers appropriately. Document repeatable processes, keep records accurate and use practical measures to identify improvements in turnaround time, quality and reliability.

title: AI Marketing
description: Own the entire marketing vertical, from paid ads and organic reach to social media, using AI tools to plan, create and improve campaigns.
details: Take end-to-end ownership of the marketing vertical: plan priorities, execute campaigns and measure results across paid ads, organic reach, social media, content and related marketing channels. Use AI tools for research, content creation and campaign workflows while checking accuracy, brand consistency and output quality. Coordinate the content calendar and channel activity, run measurable experiments, track performance and use insights to improve reach, engagement and conversion. Bring a practical, hands-on approach to building and improving the overall marketing function.
